components.name: frappe
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 release observed; common framework for the app bundle.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: erpnext
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 release observed; requires Frappe >=16.21,<17, satisfied by candidate source version.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: education
components.selection_reason: Newest non-prerelease v16 Education release observed. Prefer release commit over Phase 1 moving-branch snapshot.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.
components.risk: Release tag says 16.1.0; source __version__ says 16.0.1. SHA is authoritative; release is not Phase 1 branch head. Npm advisory lookup on 255 installed package names returned 57 advisory entries across 21 packages; triage/remediation is required. Runtime exploitability was not tested.

components.name: hrms
components.selection_reason: Payroll/Salary Slip/Leave/Employee Attendance are HRMS DocTypes, absent from ERPNext alone; required for requested full HR/payroll scope, not for minimal academics.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: bench
components.selection_reason: Released CLI instead of develop; installed through PyPI and version command and pip check succeeded.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: frappe_docker
components.selection_reason: Released deployment recipe reviewed, not a built image or runtime proof.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: python
components.selection_reason: Newest stable 3.14 tag observed; satisfies Frappe >=3.14,<3.15. Initial uv bootstrap attempted older 3.14.4, not this candidate.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: node
components.selection_reason: Newest v24 release observed; satisfies Frappe >=24 and stays on v24 instead of moving to v26.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: mariadb
components.selection_reason: Newest observed patch of 11.8 line used by pinned frappe_docker; no evidence requires moving to 12.3.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: redis
components.selection_reason: Newest observed patch of 8.6 line used by pinned frappe_docker; do not add an untested Valkey substitution or jump to 8.10.
components.upstream_support_evidence: Published release/tag plus inspected upstream manifests or deployment recipe; no SLA or lifecycle guarantee asserted.

components.name: payments
components.selection_reason: Education release billing imports Razorpay; its CI installs Payments. No published releases returned; pin explicit reviewed version-16 commit. Clean-site optionality is unproven.
components.risk: Not a gateway approval; import/install requirements must be established before enabling online payments.

components.name: yarn
components.selection_reason: Yarn Classic matches upstream yarn.lock v1; frozen install was attempted and failed on transport.

components.name: uv
components.selection_reason: Pinned to Phase 1 Bench develop requirement for initial bootstrap; NOT a qualified tool for downloading selected Python 3.14.7. Automatic resolution attempted older 3.14.4.
